summary: fractal-web binds the conversation pane to the composition Transcript, keeps retained content honest while refreshing, and re-opens ended follows. Native reasoning labels become Thinking entries, only explicitly known internal event kinds (including raw model_usage accounting) are omitted, typed native usage and unrecognized kinds remain visible, and native history owns the older-messages boundary.

compatibility.detail: UI composition and client follow-lifecycle changes only; no server protocol change. Availability, history, send state, and empty state pass to the composition Transcript.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Refreshing does not replace the last verified transcript with an empty view. Returning to a conversation retries an ended follow while retained content stays honestly stale, including interest re-acquired while eviction is still finalizing; a refused read reports its own failure without looping.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
